definitions: To cause a fire or light to stop burning or shining.
To put an end to; to destroy or suppress something completely.
To suppress or get rid of a feeling or idea.
examples: Firefighters worked to extinguish the blaze.
The company aims to extinguish all its debts.
He tried to extinguish the memory from his mind.
pastTenses: extinguished (past simple), has/have extinguished (present perfect), extinguished (past perfect)
